relay.brief: Imperial troops are closing on the Temple’s outer gate. Hold the approach for 6 turns while the guard seals the breach.

shrine.brief: Sith troopers are raiding a kyber shrine. Pilgrims swear something else came with them: a beast that hunts Jedi. Hold for 6 turns.

rescue.brief: Sith raiders hold a prisoner in a locked cell. A Medic can Hack the door from 4 tiles; a Jedi can try the console. Then walk the prisoner to an evac zone (E).

envoy.brief: A Republic envoy is leaking the peace-talk schedule. Scan his data terminals (Jedi or Medic, adjacent). Once 2 are copied, anyone who reaches an evac zone gets the data out. Capture him if you can.

archive.brief: An Imperial post is reading Republic fleet traffic. Copy its data terminals (Jedi or Medic, adjacent), then get anyone to an evac zone. Blast walls crack under explosions.

sabotage.brief: The Empire fuels its Balmorra fleet from this depot. Plant charges on 2 sites (anyone, adjacent, 1 action), then get every standing squad member onto the far evac zone. The charges blow when you are clear.

escort.brief: Someone the Empire wants dead must reach a shuttle at the far evac zone. They take one move a turn on your phase. Keep them alive.

blockade.brief: Mandalorian clans in Imperial pay are hitting a Republic supply convoy. Hold the depot for 8 turns until the Navy escort arrives.

cache.brief: An Imperial listening post is tracking Republic fleet moves. Scan its terminals (Jedi or Medic, adjacent), then get anyone to an evac zone.

hutt.brief: The Hutt broker keeps his kyber deals on warehouse terminals. Copy the ledgers and get out. His Mandalorian guards will not make it easy.

dock.brief: While the treaty is signed on Alderaan, Darth Malgus lands at Docking Ring Nine with a strike team. His target is the Temple. Stop him here.

vault.brief: You start concealed: pods patrol the ruins. Master Gnost-Dural found a sealed vault in the Ossus ruins: records from the last time the Sith struck at the Jedi. Imperial agents found it too. Scan the terminals (Jedi or Medic, adjacent), then reach evac.

ilum.brief: Sith raiders want the Ilum crystal caves. Sgt. Jace Malcom’s platoon is all that holds the mouth, and it is thin. Hold for 8 turns until his relief lands.

adraasHunt.brief: You start concealed. While the delegates talk, Lord Adraas waits in an embassy hangar for a signal. Satele Shan wants him taken off the board before it comes. Defeat him before he reaches his shuttle.

taris.brief: Sith raiders grabbed a Republic relief officer from a Taris refugee camp. Open the cell (Hack or console), then walk her to an evac zone (E).

thul.brief: Imperial agents want a young heir of House Thul dead before the talks. Walk her to the shuttle at the far evac zone.

depot.brief: The Empire fuels its Balmorra fleet from this depot. Plant charges on 2 sites (anyone, adjacent, 1 action), then get every standing squad member onto the far evac zone. The charges blow when you are clear.

fort.brief: A Republic hill fort on Ord Mantell is under Mandalorian and Sith attack. Hold it for 6 turns until the garrison regroups.

r_muster.where: Army of Light landing field · Ruusan
r_muster.brief: Lord Hoth is landing his army on Ruusan, and the Brotherhood knows it. Hold the landing beacon for 7 turns so the transports can find the field.

r_ravine.brief: Five Army of Light wounded are trapped in the ravine. Gather each civilian so they follow the column to the blue exit. Brotherhood reinforcements arrive every two turns. Save all five.
r_ravine.goal: Gather all five wounded civilians and escort them to the blue exit before the Brotherhood closes the ravine.

r_caves.brief: A Brotherhood holocron lies in Kaan’s caves. Recover it, then get its carrier to the blue extraction zone. The carrier moves two tiles slower and hunters converge once it is taken.
r_caves.goal: A Brotherhood holocron lies in Kaan’s caves. Recover it, then get its carrier to the blue extraction zone. The carrier moves two tiles slower and hunters converge once it is taken.

r_sixth.brief: The sixth battle went badly. Kaan's men dragged an Army of Light Lord, Tarsus Vell, into a stockade. A Medic can Hack the cell door from 4 tiles; a Jedi can try the console. Then get him to an evac zone (E).

r_seventh.brief: Lord Vorr commands the Brotherhood line. Defeat him to break it. At half health he gains Force lightning and calls guards; an Alchemist keeps his line standing.
r_seventh.goal: Lord Vorr commands the Brotherhood line. Defeat him to break it. At half health he gains Force lightning and calls guards; an Alchemist keeps his line standing.

r_bomb.brief: Kaan has gathered his Lords to unleash a thought bomb, a ritual that could wipe out Jedi and Sith alike. Lord Hoth is walking into the caves to stop him. Break the ritual first: defeat Kaan.

r_hospital.where: Army of Light field hospital · Ruusan
r_hospital.brief: Brotherhood raiders are coming for an Army of Light field hospital. Hold it for 6 turns while the healers move the wounded.

r_nexus.brief: A dark-side nexus is breeding Sith Spawn in the caves. Spawn only hurt Jedi. Send troops in front and destroy the nexus heart.

r_snipers.brief: Lord Farfalla's courier carries the Army's battle plans. Mercenary snipers hold the ridge. Get the courier to the shuttle.

r_dump.brief: Kaan's army runs on this dump. Plant charges on 2 sites (anyone, adjacent, 1 action), then get every standing squad member onto the evac zone.

r_prisoners.brief: The Brotherhood holds Army of Light prisoners in a locked cell. A Medic can Hack the door from 4 tiles; a Jedi can try the console. Then walk the prisoner to an evac zone (E).

r_codes.brief: A Brotherhood signal camp runs Kaan's orders to his Lords. Copy its terminals (Jedi or Medic, adjacent), then get anyone to an evac zone.

r_supply.where: Army of Light supply post · Ruusan
r_supply.brief: Brotherhood raiders want the supply post that feeds Hoth's front. Hold it for 8 turns until the convoy rolls out.

h_hetzal.brief: A starship broke apart in hyperspace. Its pieces are still falling on Hetzal at lightspeed. Masked raiders are already looting the wreck fields. Walk a survivor to the evac at the north end.

h_grove.brief: The Drengir are waking: plants that think, hunt, and eat. Their hive mother, the Great Progenitor, has rooted in a valley of farms. Cut her out before the grove spreads.

h_valo.brief: The Republic Fair: a whole world dressed up to show the frontier what the Republic can be. The Nihil came to burn it. Hold the Chancellor's pavilion for 7 turns while the crowds get out.

h_tempest.brief: Intel from Valo points to a Nihil hideout at the edge of Wild Space and one of the three Tempest Runners: Lourna Dee. Take her down before her ship jumps.

h_husks.brief: Three Jedi went into this outpost. Their comlinks still answer. They are standing in the corridors, gray as stone, and they crumble when touched. Copy the outpost logs and find out what did this.

h_beacon.brief: The Nihil are inside Starlight Beacon. The station is failing, and something on board is turning Jedi to dust. Marchion Ro is here to watch it fall. Stop him while Starlight can still be saved.

h_roots.brief: A Drengir bloom has rooted in farmland. It grows a new Drengir every few turns. Nihil scavengers are picking through what is left. Destroy the Root-Mother.

h_salvage.brief: Republic crews are pulling a fallen hull out of a field before it can kill anyone else. The Nihil want what is inside. Hold the crane for 6 turns.

h_scouts.brief: A Republic pathfinder mapped a Nihil Path and lived. The Nihil know it. Get him to the shuttle.

h_cache.brief: The Nihil hide their Path engines here, the secret that lets them strike anywhere. Plant charges on 2 sites, then get every standing squad member onto the evac zone.

h_prisoners.brief: The Nihil hold a prisoner on a barge. A Medic can Hack the cell door from 4 tiles; a Jedi can try the console. Then walk the prisoner to an evac zone (E).

h_buoy.brief: A relay is passing Nihil orders between Storms. Copy its terminals (Jedi or Medic, adjacent), then get anyone to an evac zone.

h_outpost.brief: A Republic outpost is the only beacon for twenty systems of settlers. Nihil raiders want it dark. Hold it for 8 turns.

ilsaDrop.brief: Ilsa’s SIS contact left a data drop in a Nar Shaddaa listening post. Imperial agents are working the same building. Scan the terminals, then reach evac.

brenClinic.brief: Swoop gangers in Imperial pay grabbed a volunteer from Doc Bren’s clinic. Open the cell (Hack or console), then walk her to an evac zone (E).

grakClan.brief: Clan Ordo will hear Grak only if his allies hold their proving ground against the clan’s best. Six turns. They are not playing.
